Chapter 358 - 358 An Encounter

Chapter 358 - 358 An Encounter

358 An Encounter

Eagle Country Oil Company?

Lin Fan did not know much about Eagle Country’s companies.

“Lil White, help me check the information on Eagle Country Oil Company.”

The super smart watch on Lin Fan’s wrist flashed slightly before emitting a crisp and pleasant sound.

“Eagle Country Oil Company is one of the top three companies in Eagle Country and one of the top 100 companies in the world. Its current market value is 1.05 trillion yuan. Chairman Jules Grant, the largest shareholder, holds 14.1% of the shares, and the owner holds 10% of the shares. You’re the second biggest shareholder…”

When Lin Fan heard this, he could not help but rub his nose.

The top three companies in Eagle Country?

Its current market value was 1.05 trillion.

He had 10% of the shares, which meant that he had earned 100 billion today?

Not bad!

Then, Lin Fan slowly climbed up from the bed.

When he came to the living room of the suite, he saw Chu Yunyue working hard in front of the computer.

At this moment, a crisp bell rang outside.

Chu Yunyue could not help but slowly raise her head. She was about to get up and open the door.

“Let me do it,” said Lin Fan.

As he spoke, he directly opened the door.

Two attendants were pushing a cart in the corridor. They smiled and said, “Hello, Mr. Lin. This is your breakfast.”

Lin Fan nodded. “Alright, please bring it in.”

Then, a very exquisite breakfast was placed on the dining table.

After the attendants left, Chu Yunyue asked, “When did you get up?”

“It’s only been a while,” Lin Fan said. “This breakfast looks pretty good. Come and try it.”

Just as Lin Fan had said, the breakfast was indeed not bad.

White truffle meat slices, ham, beans, and high-end bread…

The high-end ingredients and superb cooking techniques made the taste of the food explode in their mouths.

Lin Fan and Chu Yunyue were very satisfied.

Lin Fan picked up the black tea and asked, “Yunyue, do you want to try some imported black tea?”

Chu Yunyue was a little confused.

Imported black tea?

However, she still replied, “Okay.”

Lin Fan took a sip first and then leaned toward Chu Yunyue.

Gulp!

…

In the blink of an eye, two hours had passed.

Chu Yunyue changed her clothes and returned to the living room to continue working.

It could not be helped. The International Perfume Exhibition was going to be held tomorrow.

She had to prepare everything.

Lin Fan did not want to disturb Chu Yunyue’s work. At the same time, this was his first time going abroad.

Therefore, he chose to go out for a walk.

He walked on the straight sidewalk that was surrounded by houses made of steel and cement.

If it was not for the people of different skin tones passing by, Lin Fan would have thought that he was in a particular city within the country.

Of course, there were still differences between Eagle Country and Hua Nation.

Most of the people in Hua Nation worked hard and were very diligent. Therefore, even if they were walking on the streets, they looked like they were in a hurry.

As for the people in Eagle Country, everyone seemed to be very free.

In a dark alley, someone was holding a bottle of wine and swaying, almost falling to the ground.

Another person was playing the violin and singing on the street.

He also saw someone who was lying down casually…

Lin Fan walked and looked around leisurely.

At this moment, the phone in his pocket vibrated slightly.

12:00 PM!

The red packets were here!

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received three yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 1,999 yuan.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 188 yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a Ferrari 812.]

…

Lin Fan kept clicking on the red packets and got a total of 45,211 yuan and a Ferrari 812.

Lin Fan was quite familiar with this car.

In order to complete a past mission, he had specially bought one.

Lin Fan’s cars were endless.

Therefore, the Ferrari 812 was left in the Coiling Dragon Villa.

Now that he had come to Eagle Country, he did not have a single car. It was good that he had obtained one.

Lin Fan looked around, trying to find the Ferrari 812.

…

Not far away, a fair-skinned middle-aged woman whispered, “Our son has always said that he wants a sports car. What should we do? With our family’s situation, we can’t afford a sports car at all.”

The fair-skinned middle-aged man said casually, “Don’t worry, I’m already prepared. Isn’t today our son’s birthday? I bought him a fridge so that he can calm down!”

At this moment, a delivery car drove over from afar and stopped steadily in front of them.

“Are you Mr. Lauren?” the courier asked.

“It’s me,” the middle-aged man replied.

“Your express delivery has arrived,” the courier said.

As he spoke, he slowly took out a box that was half the height of a person from the back.

“See that?” The middle-aged man laughed. “It’s already here.”

As soon as the delivery car left, a young man with golden hair walked over.

In the next moment, he could not take his eyes off something.

He had found a brand-new supercar parked by the roadside. It was his favorite open-top supercar, the Ferrari 812!

The middle-aged man smiled and said, “Son, I’ve prepared a birthday present for you! Do you like it?”

Birthday present?

Was it this Ferrari 812?

That was right!

This must be the case!

The young man said excitedly, “I like it, I like it so much! Daddy, I knew you loved me!”

Then, without waiting for the middle-aged man’s reply, he impatiently came to the front of the Ferrari 812 and gently stroked the body of the car. He touched the soft interior… His slightly freckled face was overcome with delight.

At this moment, a tall young woman walked over and asked in surprise, “Is this your car?”

“Yes, it is! My father prepared this as a birthday present for me!” the young man said.

“That’s great! Didn’t you want me to be your girlfriend? I agree!” the young woman said.

“Good! Hahaha!” The young man shouted happily and then hugged the young woman in his arms.

While they were hugging, they did not notice a Hua Nation man coming to the front of the Ferrari 812. He slowly opened the door and got in.

This person… was Lin Fan.

Lin Fan naturally did not care about the two people hugging each other. He stepped on the accelerator and sped away.

The young man seemed to have heard the sound as well. He hurriedly let go of the young woman and shouted with his eyes wide open, “Hey! My car! My car!”

He shouted as he chased.

However, how could his two legs catch up to the four wheels of a supercar?

The young man had no choice but to return and call out, “Dad, call the police! The Ferrari 812 you gave me was stolen!”

The middle-aged man opened his mouth and said, “That’s not my birthday present to you. The real birthday present is actually this refrigerator.”

“What?” The young man’s eyes widened.

“So, you don’t have a sports car. Then I’m not your girlfriend.”
